reading.zh: 最上面是编排，接着按实际执行顺序排的各组检查（运行时文件 → DLSS5 → 子插件 → Mod/中转 → 面板键位），最下面是修复入口 —— 它**故意就是同一条链**，而不是第二套实现。
reading.en: Top is the orchestration, then the check groups in the order they run (runtime files → DLSS5 → sub-plugins → mods/staging → panel keys), and at the bottom the repair entry — which is deliberately the same chain, not a second implementation.
